<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, type Component } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { TABS_KEY, panelId, tabId, type TabValue } from "./Tabs.vue";
import { TAB_LIST_KEY } from "./TabList.vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value: TabValue;
    label?: string;
    icon?: string | Component;
    disabled?: boolean;
    class?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    label: "",
    disabled: false,
  },
);

const slots = defineSlots<{
  prefix?: () => unknown;
  default?: () => unknown;
  suffix?: () => unknown;
}>();

const context = inject(TABS_KEY);
if (!context) throw new Error("<TabTrigger> must be used inside <Tabs>.");
const list = inject(TAB_LIST_KEY);
if (!list) throw new Error("<TabTrigger> must be used inside <TabList>.");

const selected = computed(() => context.selected.value === props.value);
const isVertical = computed(() => list.orientation.value === "vertical");

const sizeClasses = {
  sm: "h-8 px-2.5 text-sm",
  md: "h-9 px-3 text-sm",
};

const triggerVariantClasses = {
  underline: {
    base: "text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected:
      "text-ink-gray-8 after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:-bottom-px after:h-px after:bg-outline-gray-8",
    verticalSelected:
      "text-ink-gray-8 after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:-right-px after:w-px after:bg-outline-gray-8",
  },
  subtle: {
    base: "rounded-(--radius-3) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8 shadow-sm",
    verticalSelected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8 shadow-sm",
  },
  ghost: {
    base: "rounded-(--radius-3) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-gray-3 text-ink-gray-8",
    verticalSelected: "rounded-(--radius-3) bg-surface-gray-3 text-ink-gray-8",
  },
  "browser-tab": {
    base: "rounded-t-(--radius-4) text-ink-gray-5 hover:text-ink-gray-7",
    selected:
      "-mb-px rounded-t-(--radius-4) border border-outline-gray-2 border-b-surface-base bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8",
    verticalSelected:
      "-mr-px rounded-l-(--radius-4) border border-outline-gray-2 border-r-surface-base bg-surface-base text-ink-gray-8",
  },
};

const classes = computed(() => {
  const variantClasses = triggerVariantClasses[list.variant.value];
  return cn(
    "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-medium outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-outline-gray-4 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
    sizeClasses[list.size.value],
    variantClasses.base,
    selected.value &&
      (isVertical.value
        ? variantClasses.verticalSelected
        : variantClasses.selected),
    list.variant.value === "browser-tab" && "px-3",
    isVertical.value && "w-full justify-start",
    props.class,
  );
});

function onClick() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  context.select(props.value);
}
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    role="tab"
    :id="tabId(context.baseId, props.value)"
    :aria-selected="selected"
    :aria-controls="panelId(context.baseId, props.value)"
    :aria-label="props.label && !slots.default ? props.label : undefined"
    :tabindex="props.disabled ? -1 : selected ? 0 : -1"
    :disabled="props.disabled"
    data-slot="tab-trigger"
    :data-state="selected ? 'active' : 'inactive'"
    :class="classes"
    @click="onClick"
  >
    <slot name="prefix" />
    <span
      v-if="typeof props.icon === 'string'"
      :class="props.icon"
      class="size-3.5"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
    <component
      v-else-if="props.icon"
      :is="props.icon"
      class="size-3.5"
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
    <slot>{{ props.label }}</slot>
    <slot name="suffix" />
  </button>
</template>
/* Part of the Tabs compound component. */
